# Project Rules

- Use only `pandas` and `matplotlib` for data analysis and visualization in this project.
- Do not add other Python libraries for data processing or plotting unless the user explicitly requests them.
- When working in notebooks, add explanatory comments in Arabic to clarify the logic and steps.
- Keep the code simple, readable, and aligned with the restaurant data analysis context.
- For charts, prefer `matplotlib` and use clear labels/titles in English when necessary, while keeping narrative comments in Arabic.
